sentences.l2: 在今天的互联网上，很多人喜欢在虚拟世界里玩游戏。
sentences.l1: On the internet today, many people like to play games in virtual worlds.

sentences.l2: 这些游戏不只是一个人玩的，经常需要和其他玩家一起。
sentences.l1: These games are not played by just one person, and often need you to be together with other players.

sentences.l2: 有时候，大家组成一个团队合作，一起去完成任务。
sentences.l1: Sometimes, everyone forms a team to cooperate and goes to complete a task together.

sentences.l2: 比如，要打败一个很强的怪物，一个人很难成功，但五个人一起计划、互相帮助，就容易多了。
sentences.l1: For example, to defeat a very strong monster, it is hard for one person to succeed, but if five people plan together and help each other, it is much easier.

sentences.l2: 这种协作的过程让玩家觉得有趣，也让他们交到朋友。
sentences.l1: This process of collaboration makes players find it fun, and also lets them make friends.

sentences.l2: 除了团队合作，游戏里也有竞争。
sentences.l1: Besides teamwork, there is also competition in games.

sentences.l2: 比如两个队伍比赛，看谁先拿到旗帜或者谁得分更高。
sentences.l1: For example, two teams compete to see who gets the flag first or who scores higher.

sentences.l2: 虽然大家在竞争，但每个队伍内部还是需要协作。
sentences.l1: Although everyone is competing, inside each team collaboration is still needed.

sentences.l2: 好的团队会听队长的指挥，有人负责进攻，有人保护队友。
sentences.l1: A good team will listen to the captain's commands, with some people responsible for attacking and some protecting teammates.

sentences.l2: 这样的游戏不仅考验技术，也考验沟通和配合。
sentences.l1: Such games test not only skill, but also communication and coordination.

sentences.l2: 有些玩家来自不同的国家，他们用简单的中文或英语交流。
sentences.l1: Some players come from different countries, and they communicate in simple Chinese or English.

sentences.l2: 时间久了，他们的语言能力也会提高。
sentences.l1: As time goes by, their language ability will also improve.

sentences.l2: 虽然大家没见过面，但在虚拟世界里，他们成了很好的伙伴。
sentences.l1: Although they have never met, in the virtual world they have become good partners.

sentences.l2: 有时候，游戏结束了，他们还在聊天，分享生活中的事情。
sentences.l1: Sometimes, the game is over and they are still chatting, sharing things from their lives.

sentences.l2: 这种在线游戏社区，不只是玩游戏的地方，也是一个让人学习协作、面对竞争、理解他人的环境。
sentences.l1: This kind of online game community is not only a place for playing games, but also an environment for learning collaboration, facing competition and understanding others.

sentences.l2: 玩家在这里学会尊重规则，也学会为团队努力。
sentences.l1: Here, players learn to respect the rules, and also learn to work hard for the team.

sentences.l2: 虽然世界是虚拟的，但学到的东西是真实的。
sentences.l1: Although the world is virtual, what is learned is real.
